basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) has released the official Jr. Research Fellow & Research Associate Notification 2026 at https://home.iitd.ac.in/. A total of 2 vacancies have been announced under the IIT Delhi Jr. Research Fellow & Research Associate Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates with 1st Class B.Tech/ M.Tech/ M.Sc. in Electrical/ ECE/ Physics/ Engineering Physics or a relevant field, or a PhD in Physics/ Electrical Engineering/ Photonics or a related area can apply through email on or before 03 August 2026. Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Delhi Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 1 for Jr. Research Fellow and 1 for Research Associate.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Jr. Research Fellow: 1st class B. Tech/M. Tech./M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication Engineering/Physics/Engineering Physics or other relevant field. Strong knowledge of electromagnetic necessary. Prior experience with photonics preferred. NET/GATE may be relaxed for CFTI graduates with CGPA >8.000 Research Associate: PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Photonics or relevant area with research focus in photonic circuit design and measurement. Experience with Ansys Lumerical preferred

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Jr. Research Fellow: Rs.37,000/- p.m. plus HRA @27% Research Associate: Rs.58,000/- p.m. plus HRA @27%

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Delhi Jr. Research Fellow / Research Associate posts is 03 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: For Jr. Research Fellow, a 1st class B.Tech/M.Tech/M.Sc. in relevant fields is required. For Research Associate, a PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or Photonics is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by IIT Delhi for the positions of Jr. Research Fellow and Research Associate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 37,000/- per month for Jr. Research Fellow and Rs. 58,000/- per month for Research Associate, plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates are required to apply via email for these positions. Ensure all necessary documents are attached and the subject line is correctly mentioned.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Jr. Research Fellow / Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an online interview for the eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for the applicants. However, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, New Delhi, Delhi - 110016.
